parent_objective: Trustworthy double-click bootstrap detects locally installed Sims 4, learns real process and menu state, and resumes the actual most recently played game unattended where safe, without endangering players' saves or desktop sovereignty.

candidates.thesis: Blindly click Resume after spawning Sims
candidates.reason: Resume is explicitly forbidden; wrong save and unknown game scene can change protected user state.

candidates.thesis: Inspect arbitrary user saves and choose newest file
candidates.reason: File timestamps do not prove in-game recency or displayed save identity; current protected-save contract prohibits inspecting user saves.

candidates.thesis: Deterministic unattended game launch with explicit provenance, read-only PID/menu observations, bounded fail-closed handoff
candidates.reason: Can automate known safe dispatch without a new mouse controller or weakening save protection.

candidates.thesis: Reuse existing calibrated disposable-save host navigator for all users
candidates.reason: Template coordinates, lab attestation and exact version are environment-specific; generalization requires actual Windows P08 proof.

p141.selected_thesis: Deterministic unattended game launch and observable PID/menu handoff; protected-save auto-resume remains blocked until verified opt-in save identity and a calibrated host-side effect gate exist.

acceptance: unique known installation launches only after a deliberate double-click without a second button
ambiguous or missing executables do not guess and can fall back to the current chooser
process PID is reported as dispatch-only, not a verified live-game process
no auto Resume/load/select of unknown or protected saves
no duplicate launch on untrusted or active-game ownership
offline regression tests cover negative boundaries
main merge and real Windows host proof remain independently evidenced
p08: NOT_RUN: No Windows Sims game/EA installation or calibrated screenshot available in GitHub connector runtime.
